role: new independent final source-only audit; no repair, key, grading, reader or reviewer role

normative_scope.official: Standard 3–6-player multiplayer core through Rules p42; 1710,1758,1813,Long1710 and firms/deregulation, with applicable official corrections and supplied designer rulings. Component-specific powers/holdings/map layouts remain read from original components.
normative_scope.human: Exact attributed human interpretation: combined strength of newly exhausted defense pieces >= attacking strength defeats the Crisis, including indivisible local-alliance strength.
normative_scope.excluded: Crown solo/two-player rules/handbook, difficulty settings, optional setup-card Draft, prior audit/repair/history or assessment material, questions, keys, readers, drafts, grades, model/session logs, web research and repository instructions.

coverage.short_quote_or_visual_transcription: Source boundary: This is a playable procedural summary used with board and cards.

source_application_and_inference.basis: Rules p37 says a firm special retirement is otherwise like a pensioner retirement. Applying p12 display eligibility/spending ranking follows that rule; final scoring explicitly has no display cards.
Rules p22 says target strength plus associated empire regions; p6–7 define combined empire strength. Counting target once avoids duplicating the targeted region.
Company target has no tower/faceup loot modifier; Rules p23 still prescribes minimum loot of surviving participating officers+1. The summary derives that result without adding a new rule.
Rules p39 identifies the primary as the firm remaining after merger, while secondary firms transfer assets and flip back; no instruction resets primary value/dividend cubes.
Rules p37 instructs totaling earned firm VP then rounding remaining fractions down; applied once to each player’s total across firms. Debtor’s Prison is independently −1 per piece on p41.

source_application_and_inference.classification: explicit human authority, not independently verified official text
source_application_and_inference.basis: Printed p33 uses equality language; human supplied >= instruction expressly replaces that comparison within this scoped summary. The source’s claimed email remains unverified provenance and does not block this user-approved scope.

limitations: PASS applies only to the frozen hash and the explicit official-plus-human scope.
No independently verified publisher email or unqualified official-core signoff is given.
Individual card effects, initial holdings and exact scenario/map layouts are intentionally used from components; the candidate’s rules for using them were audited.
